subject: Custody evidence rotation and license locality — MSA & Order Form alignment
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@archonhealth.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@archonhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Custody evidence rotation & residency question

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are working the security checklist internally and a couple of items around private/on-prem deployments need clarification before procurement can sign the Order Form. High-level asks: 

1) Evidence rotation: our auditors want a clear process for handing over periodic custody evidence (snapshots, manifests) and rotation of any operator / console access used during witness events. Does Redwood support a timeboxed witness flow (e.g., 48h concierge access) and a signed/sealed hash manifest for each rotation?

2) License locality: the MSA currently references broad territory language. For our regulatory posture we need the license/operational residency to be demonstrably US-only for the on-prem variant and a clause that prevents derivative residency transfer without our written consent.

3) Third‑party witness: we may ask for a neutral auditor to observe the handoff. Would Redwood accept a mutually-approved witness or require a sealed-hash approach instead?

I've attached a first-pass list (custody-manifest.csv) and the procurement team flagged pricing if additional witness labor is required. Can you and your legal team propose language that maps into the Order Form (exhibit or special term)?

Appreciate a quick read — Emily

Attachments: custody-manifest.csv

--
Emily Park
Head of Technical Procurement, Archon Health
emily.park@archonhealth.com

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily.park@archonhealth.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-04T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custody evidence rotation & residency question

Emily —

Thanks for the clear list. High-level proposal from our side that should address audit and procurement concerns: 

- Witness flow: we can offer a timeboxed concierge access window (default 48 hours) where an operator executes the snapshot/handover. During that window, we can provide either a live Zoom witness session with screen share and recorded logs, or (if you prefer no live access) provide a sealed SHA-256 manifest for the snapshot plus an operator-signed affidavit.

- Residency & license locality: propose an Order Form Exhibit (Exhibit F: Residency & License Locality) that pins the deployment residency to the US for the specific on-prem variant listed on the Order Form. The exhibit will state that model weights, snapshots, and any derived artifacts will not be exported from the US without customer written consent.

- Third‑party witness: we are open to a mutually-approved third-party observer. If Archon requests a third-party, we will require a short NDA and a defined scope (no shell access, observe-only, timeboxed). Alternatively, we can include a built-in sealed-hash handover path to avoid third-party presence.

I'll ask legal to draft suggested redline language for the MSA and a short Order Form exhibit we can attach. Marcus / Steph — can you take the lead on a redline and a short witness-runbook (runbook attached)? Emily — is Tuesday afternoon next week available for a 30-minute alignment call?

Attachments: witness-runbook-v1.docx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Archon Health Legal <legal@archonhealth.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@archonhealth.com>, procurement@archonhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-05T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Custody evidence rotation & residency question

Vanessa —

Appreciate the quick reply and the two options (live witness vs sealed-hash). A few comments from legal: 

1) We need explicit contract language that the sealed-hash manifest will be produced in a machine-readable format (CSV or JSON) and that Redwood will retain the pre-handover hashes for 12 months for audit verification.

2) For the residency exhibit: we prefer the following edits — (a) carve a definition of "Derived Artifacts" to include tokenized models, embeddings, and fine-tuned checkpoints; (b) add an export prohibition that survives termination for 12 months unless there is a court order.

3) Third‑party witness: legal is comfortable but will require the third‑party to be an independent accredited firm and to sign the third‑party NDA and a limited-scope observer agreement. We would also like an SLA window for Redwood to respond if a hash mismatch is detected during verification (suggest 5 business days for root-cause / remediation response).

4) Pricing: procurement flagged incremental fees for third-party coordination and for an on-site operator. Please send a short pricing appendix that shows a one-time witness fee and hourly operator rate so procurement can close the commercial thread.

Can Redwood circulate a redline of the proposed MSA language and a draft Order Form exhibit? We'd also like to run a short (30min) legal + security call; Emily and I are available Wednesday 10–12 PT.

- Steph: prepare a one-page pricing appendix with (a) one-time witness fee (onsite or live remote), (b) operator hourly rate for on-site witness windows, and (c) optional third-party coordination fee (if we facilitate). Add a short blurb on what is included in the witness-runbook.
